title: equisetum limosum var. linnaeanum
intro: Equisetum limosum var. linnaeanum, commonly known as Marsh Horsetail, is a perennial plant species belonging to the family Equisetaceae. It has been traditionally used for its health benefits, including its ability to help with urinary issues, kidney stones, and as a diuretic to alleviate edema and fluid retention. The therapeutic actions of Marsh Horsetail include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antifungal properties, which may help in treating wounds, infections, and skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of Marsh Horsetail include flavonoids, saponins, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
